display_name: DURA 三专家物理门控 GPU 训练
description: 冻结 DURA，独立初始化三个多尺度恢复专家，用单条接收 IQ 的物理特征融合各专家；源域配对 IQ 训练。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off; source prepare batch 32, train batch 32, ground/scoring CPU 2 threads

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0; three independently initialized zero-head multiscale corrections and fresh source-trained gate
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA source-only provenance checked by frozen_dura; 32768 fit IDs sampled only from matching source L_s/U_s after held-out exclusions
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed source-only DURA, fresh correction experts and gate, no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, at most one this-run worker and at most 3 total compute workers including others; check capacity; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.method: Three independent DURA correction experts softly mixed by per-record estimated noise, innovation energy and received energy
rows.purpose: Train five-epoch source-only physics-conditioned mixture at fixed 32768-ID budget
rows.seed_notes: Correction seed 2026110612, source fit seed 2026110611, order seed 2026110613; fixed DURA seed 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: Frozen DURA 266951 parameters, three experts and gate 351301 parameters, total 618252; 32768 source IDs x three views, five epochs batch32; cached source context; three full correction branches at inference

notes: Three independently initialized multiscale DURA correction experts; learned softmax gate uses only each received record, DURA anchor, estimated physical innovation and noise variance.
All expert heads initialize at zero; initial output equals DURA; gate starts uniform and is trainable after expert outputs diverge.
Source-only IQ loss plus DURA guard; 32768 fixed source IDs x 3 views, five epochs, batch32, AdamW learning rate 0.0003 weight decay 0.001.
No F weights or outputs, TX labels, V or target data are used in recovery training; deterministic source context cache reused.
Freeze final epoch without source/target score selection; all 168000 records in seven Phase1 views predicted before independent truth-last scoring with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
Three expert branches increase inference compute and memory relative to one expert; actual runtime not yet measured.
